description: Path traversal and file disclosure vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.
User enumeration vulnerability in OpenSSH 7.2 and earlier via long password attempts.
Backdoor execution vulnerability in vsftpd 2.3.4 download package, allowing remote root command execution.
Path traversal and remote code execution vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 (incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773).
1-byte memory overwrite vulnerability in Nginx DNS resolver, allowing remote attackers to trigger denial of service or code execution.
Remote root code execution vulnerability in MySQL 5.5, 5.6, and 5.7 via configuration file injection.
Double-free memory corruption vulnerability in OpenSSH ssh-agent, potentially allowing local code execution.
Mod_rewrite open redirect vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.0 through 2.4.41 via unescaped carriage return characters.
Unauthenticated file copy vulnerability in mod_copy in ProFTPD 1.3.5, allowing remote site-to-site copy and execution.
Out-of-bounds heap read/write vulnerability in Samba vfs_fruit module, leading to remote root command execution.
Use-after-free vulnerability in Exim Mail Transfer Agent, allowing unauthenticated remote command execution as root.
Apache Tomcat AJP Connector file read/inclusion vulnerability (Ghostcat), allowing remote file reading and code execution.
SQL injection and privilege escalation vulnerability in PostgreSQL via search_path configuration settings.
OpenSSH username enumeration vulnerability via malformed packets, exposing investigator/system usernames.
SQL Injection vulnerability in WordPress core query classes, leading to complete database takeover.
Integer overflow leading to heap corruption in Redis lua scripting modules, causing crashes or command execution.
Remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft IIS HTTP.sys via custom range headers (MS15-034).
Assertion failure denial of service vulnerability in BIND DNS resolver daemon via TSIG response processing.
Arbitrary file upload and remote code execution vulnerability in Drupal core via double extensions file handling.
Remote code execution vulnerability in OpenSSH ssh-agent PKCS#11 module loading settings.
